cards.ex: Hang in there — the week is almost over.
Don't hesitate to ask. → No need to hurry. (hesitate to + 동사 / in a hurry = 급한)
I've never tried yoga, but I'll give it a shot.
I regret not calling her. → They canceled the flight. (regret + -ing)
On second thought, let's order pizza instead.

quiz.q: I know it's tough, but ___ — you're almost done.
quiz.note: hang in there = 힘들어도 버텨라. 응원의 한마디!

quiz.q: Don't ___ to call me if you need help.
quiz.note: Don't hesitate to + 동사 = 주저 말고 ~하세요. 이메일 마무리 단골!

quiz.q: I'm not sure I can do it, but I'll ___ .
quiz.note: give it a shot = 한번 해보다. try의 캐주얼 버전!

quiz.q: Let's go out. ___ , it's raining — let's stay in.
quiz.note: on second thought = 다시 생각해 보니. 마음 바꿀 때!

cards.ex: We hit it off right away at the party.
We anticipate delays. → Let's adjust the schedule. (adjust to = ~에 적응하다)
Our travel plans are still up in the air.
The data is accurate. → What's the exact time? (accurate = 오차 없는, exact = 정확히 그것)
It took a month to learn the ropes at my new job.

quiz.q: My sister and my boyfriend ___ immediately.
We ___ a lot of questions after the presentation.
quiz.note: anticipate + 대상 = 미리 예상하다. expect보다 '대비'의 느낌!
up in the air = 아직 확정 안 된. on the air는 '방송 중'!

quiz.q: Is this figure ___ ? It looks too high.
Give her a week to ___ before judging her work.
quiz.note: learn the ropes = 신입이 일을 익히다. 배에서 온 표현!

cards.ex: Stop beating around the bush and tell me.
She showed genuine interest. → Be precise with the numbers. (genuine = 가짜 아닌)

cards.ko: 모두 알지만 말 안 하는 문제
cards.ex: Let's address the elephant in the room — the budget.
We reached a compromise. → She accomplished her goal. (reach a compromise)
After three failed attempts, he threw in the towel.

quiz.hint: 덤불 주위를 돌다 = 빙빙 돌려 말하다
quiz.note: beat around the bush = 핵심을 피해 돌려 말하다. 반대는 get to the point!
genuine = 진짜의·진심의. genuinely sorry = 진심으로 미안한.

quiz.q: Nobody mentioned the layoffs — it was ___ .
quiz.note: 모두가 알지만 아무도 꺼내지 않는 문제 = the elephant in the room.

quiz.q: Neither side got everything, but we reached a ___ .
quiz.note: reach a compromise = 타협에 이르다. 동사로도 '타협하다'!

quiz.q: Don't ___ yet — you're so close to finishing.
quiz.note: 권투에서 수건 던지면 기권. give up의 관용구!
